description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mehi Ella, Mehi Ella South, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420203
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
